---
name: Dev Issue Template
about: This is for developers to create detailed, ready to work issues
title: Feature/
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Summary

Briefly describe the issue or feature request in one or two sentences.

## Motivation

Explain why this issue matters, what problem it solves, or what value it adds.

## Requirements

List key technical or functional requirements that must be met for completion.

## Acceptance Criteria

Define clear, testable conditions that determine when this issue is complete.

## Proposed Solution

Outline a possible approach, implementation plan, or next steps.

## Additional Context

Include relevant links, references, logs, screenshots, or design notes.
